contributions.claim: A Guardian headline reports an Indian pilot recalling a flydubai cockpit attack, describing a fight for his life and being hailed as a hero.
contributions.attribution: The Guardian headline, including a quotation attributed in the headline to the pilot
contributions.materiality: Introduces the cockpit attack matter and the pilot’s retrospective account.
contributions.uncertainty: Only the headline supports this account; the text is a photograph credit. Pilot identity, attack date, flight, participants, and outcomes are absent.

delta_expectations.reason: Promotional app copy supplies no news development.
A narrowly worded headline-level attack/account item is supported; no additional attack details are supported.

missing_evidence_reason: The pilot item contains only a headline and photograph credit, so detailed event reconstruction is unsupported.
ambiguity_notes: No relationship between the BBC app promotion and the pilot item is evidenced.
The article publication timestamp must not be treated as the attack date.
